HEADER: Init +1; Senses Dragon senses, tremorsense 120 ft.; Perception +13
DEFENSE: AC 21, touch 12, flat-footed 20 (+1 dex, +9 natural, +1 size)
Immune Earth, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Lightning 50%
OFFENSE: Space 2.5 ft.; Reach 0 ft. (5 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks Breath Weapon (40-ft. line, 2d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 17 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Mud Gun, Slow Breath (20-ft. cone, DC 17)
At will - detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic
2nd (DC 15) - binding earth, elemental resistance, groundswell, soften earth and stone, stone call, wall climb
STATISTICS: Str 20, Dex 12, Con 18, Int 7, Wis 16, Cha 10
Base Atk +7; CMB +11; CMD 22 (26 vs. trip)
Feats Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness
Skills Bluff +10, Climb +19, Intimidate +10, Perception +13, Stealth +19; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth
SPECIAL ABILITIES: As a standard action, a brown dragon can shoot mud out of its mouth towards a single target with an earth projectile. The brown dragon must make a ranged touch attack (+9), if it hits, the attack deals 1d6+2 earth damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 16) or be inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 17).
Instead of a line of jagged rocks, a brown dragon can breathe a cone of slowing gas. Those in the cone must make a Fortitude save or be slowed (as per the spell slow) for 1d4 rounds.

Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, the brown dragon releases a raging fierce roar, boosting their personal attack power. This adds a +6 morale bonus to all attack rolls for seven rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

curation.summary: Wyrmling Brown Dragon is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 27 generated item(s) across 8 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
